facts.fact: 亚当与 Vic 前来观看的压轴歌手卡塞德拉（Cathedra）是个把巫术织进音乐里的女巫。
facts.anchor: Cathedra was a witch who’d woven the craft into her music.

facts.fact: 演出中 Vic 把降噪耳机塞进亚当的耳朵，还吻了他的脸颊——两人是伴侣。
facts.anchor: Vic tucked the earbuds into Adam’s ears. He kissed Adam’s cheek

facts.fact: 亚当最近被暂停了「宝剑侍从」（Page of Swords）的职务；当地女巫们对他的新好感多半因此而来。
facts.anchor: his recent suspension from his role as the Page of Swords

facts.fact: 台上冲入的男子发出的尖叫之歌放倒了全场——亚当是唯一还站着的人，连酒保都瘫倒在地，Jodi 等人也悉数倒下。
facts.anchor: Adam was the only one still standing. Even the bartender, his till open, had slumped to the floor.

facts.fact: Vic 也在歌声中瘫倒，亚当一把接住他，把他放到地上。
facts.anchor: Adam turned to Vic, who was already slumping. Catching him with a grunt, Adam lowered him to the ground.

facts.fact: 那生物的几缕触须状发丝像刀子一样刺穿了卡塞德拉，鲜血喷涌。
facts.anchor: Several drove into Cathedra, piercing her like knives in a gout of blood

facts.fact: 亚当抓住一根触须，打开心口的「术士之伤」——他当初为束缚另一个灵体而刻出的洞——吞食了那灵体的一部分。
facts.anchor: opened the warlock wound, the hole in his heart he’d carved to bind another spirit

facts.fact: 一道弧形刀刃扫过，在触须抓到亚当之前将它们斩断；受伤的生物随即冲上天花板逃走。
facts.anchor: An arcing blade swept out, slicing the strands before they caught him.
